# GEMM sweep shapes. Regenerate an app with:
#   scripts/gen_gemm_shape_app.sh M N P [16|32]
# There is no per-shape config: the MSHR tuning is derived at compile time from the
# GEMM_M/N/P macros in the generated data_gemm.h (software/runtime/mshr_cfg.h).
